# Google Workspace Add-ons & Chat App Engineering

## Purpose

Build Google Workspace Add-ons, Google Chat apps, and Workspace Studio extensions using CardService, host manifests, contextual/homepage cards, navigation/actions, Chat responses, workflow steps/starters, workflowTriggers, lifecycle callbacks, OAuth, and membership-visibility UI states. Use for Workspace-native add-on/chat/studio UX.
